name: death-left
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite animation sheet of the EXACT accepted zombie decayed human villager shown in the reference, which is an IDENTITY/STYLE reference only, NOT layout to copy. Same gaunt adult human, cloudy dead white eyes, sparse messy dark hair, gray-green decayed skin, ragged dirty beige sleeveless linen tunic, dull brown belt and torn brown trousers and worn brown shoes; unarmed empty five-fingered human hands. Detailed shaded textured retro dungeon illustration, crisp edges and muted materials, same lighting/proportions/clothing tears and anatomy. Human ears, no weapons/armor, never cute. Genuine TRANSPARENT alpha background and alpha holes, no background, floor, painted shadow, glow, grid, labels or text. Generous transparent outer margins and between poses; no silhouette may touch its neighbor or sheet edge. Same anatomical scale in all frames. STRICT LEFT PROFILE faces screen-LEFT. Exactly FOUR COMPLETE death/corpse poses in FOUR EQUAL QUADRANTS of a 2x2 square grid, preferably 1536x1536. EACH FIGURE MUST FIT WHOLLY IN ITS OWN QUADRANT with a very WIDE central transparent vertical gutter, min100px. Reading top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Frame1 upright zombie reels facing LEFT, knees buckle, standing anatomical height about400px. Frame2 low kneeling slump facing LEFT. Frame3 falls forward LEFT onto side, headLEFT shoesRIGHT. Frame4 final motionless flat corpse headLEFT shoesRIGHT, face/chest/near side visible, limp hands near head. Same anatomical/limb scale allframes; lower poses NOT enlarged to standing height. The corpse length must be NO MORE THAN450px and centered in its OWN quadrant: lower left entirely LEFT of centerline and lower right entirely RIGHT of centerline. Do NOT stagger or overlap figures. Wide blank horizontal gutter too. Whole head/fingers/shoes visible. No floor, pool, effect or resurrection.
